name: New Mexico

flag.description: A yellow field with a red Zia sun symbol in the centre: a circle with four groups of four rays pointing in the four directions.
flag.symbolism: Red and yellow are the colours of Spain, and the Zia sun, taken from the Zia Pueblo, groups everything in fours: directions, seasons, times of day and stages of life.

hook: New Mexico is a red sun on yellow with its rays in four tidy bundles; North Macedonia flips the colours to a yellow sun on red.
trivia: A 2001 North American Vexillological Association survey rated New Mexico's flag the best design among US state, territory and Canadian provincial flags.
The Zia sun symbol comes from the Zia Pueblo, whose people regard the number four as sacred.
